name: Cusino (Italy)
description: White field charged at the centre with the crowned municipal arms of Cusino (three flowers on red above a mountain on blue) within branches, with the inscription COMUNE DI CUSINO in grey above.
history: Municipal flag of Cusino, a comune in Lombardy; Italian municipal arms, gonfaloni and flags are granted by decree of the President of the Republic on the advice of the Government's heraldry office.

features.role: Cusino arms — three flowers on red above a mountain on blue, crowned, within branches
inscription COMUNE DI CUSINO above the arms
